hooks.command:
python -c "
import json, os
skills = [
    'skills/senior-architect/SKILL.md',
    'skills/clean-code/SKILL.md',
    'skills/react-best-practices/SKILL.md',
    'skills/frontend-design/SKILL.md'
]
content = ''
for s in skills:
    try:
        with open(s, encoding='utf-8') as f:
            content += '\n\n=== ' + s + ' ===\n' + f.read()
    except Exception as e:
        content += '\n\n=== ' + s + ' === ERROR: ' + str(e)
print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'SessionStart', 'additionalContext': content.strip()}}))
"
